definitions.explanation: Warm goodwill and solidarity among friends or among people in general. A formal word found in speeches, mottos and political ideals, as in liberty, equality and fraternity.

examples.japanese: {友愛|ゆうあい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧。
{友愛|ゆうあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧。

⟦フランス→フランス：19418_furansu⟧⟦{革命|かくめい}→革命：05968_kakumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{理念|りねん}→理念：06027_rinen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧・⟦{平等|びょうどう}→平等：03590_byoudou⟧・{友愛|ゆうあい}だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The ideals of the French Revolution are said to be liberty, equality and fraternity.

notes:
Much more formal than ⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧. It tends to describe an ideal or a principle rather than the friendship between two particular people.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {友愛|ゆうあい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{精神|せいしん}→精神：03377_seishin⟧: the spirit of fraternity
- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧・⟦{平等|びょうどう}→平等：03590_byoudou⟧・{友愛|ゆうあい}: liberty, equality, fraternity
- {友愛|ゆうあい}⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧: a fraternal association

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧: friendship — the everyday word for the bond between friends
- ⟦{博愛|はくあい}→博愛：19139_hakuai⟧: philanthropy, love for all humanity — wider in scope
